rows.title: Russia–Ukraine War
rows.event: Attritional front largely static; artillery, drones and deep strikes define the fighting; Western aid and mobilisation remain decisive variables.

rows.title: Armenia–Azerbaijan (Karabakh aftermath)
rows.event: Karabakh depopulated after 2023; focus shifted to a border-delimitation and peace-treaty track between Yerevan and Baku.

rows.title: Georgia — Abkhazia / South Ossetia
rows.event: Russian-backed breakaway regions remain outside Tbilisi's control; line of contact quiet but unresolved.

rows.title: Moldova — Transnistria
rows.event: Russian troops and a self-declared republic persist on the Dniester; energy leverage is the main pressure lever.

rows.title: Israel–Hamas War (Gaza)
rows.event: Phased ceasefire and hostage-release framework in effect but repeatedly strained; reconstruction and governance of Gaza unresolved.

rows.title: Israel–Hezbollah (Lebanon)
rows.event: US/France-brokered ceasefire holding unevenly; disputes over withdrawal lines and Hezbollah disarmament recur.

rows.title: Syria — Post-Assad Transition
rows.event: Interim authority consolidating after Assad's fall; sectarian violence, Kurdish integration and foreign strikes complicate the transition.

rows.title: Yemen — Houthi Conflict / Red Sea
rows.event: Houthi forces conduct periodic Red Sea shipping attacks; internal front lines frozen amid stalled UN-led talks.

rows.title: Iraq — ISIS remnants
rows.event: Residual ISIS cells persist in rural areas; focus turned to militia politics and US-troop drawdown negotiations.

rows.title: Iran–Israel shadow & direct strikes
rows.event: Escalated from proxy shadow-war to direct exchanges of strikes; nuclear programme and regional deterrence are the flashpoints.

rows.title: Turkey–PKK insurgency
rows.event: A 2025 PKK disarmament/dissolution process is underway, potentially ending one of the region's longest insurgencies.

rows.title: Israel — West Bank unrest
rows.event: Recurrent Israeli raids, settler violence and militant attacks; settlement expansion sharpens tensions.

rows.title: Turkey–Syria (SDF/YPG)
rows.event: Turkish operations against Kurdish-led SDF continue; post-Assad realignment reopens questions on north-east Syria.

rows.title: Israel–Syria strikes
rows.event: Israel struck Syrian military assets during and after the transition, seizing a buffer zone near the Golan.

rows.title: US–Iran Gulf standoff
rows.event: Naval frictions in the Strait of Hormuz persist alongside sanctions pressure and nuclear diplomacy.

rows.title: Iran — Baloch/Kurdish unrest
rows.event: Sporadic clashes with Baloch (Jaish al-Adl) and Kurdish groups continue in the periphery.

rows.title: Libya — Civil conflict
rows.event: Rival Tripoli and eastern administrations hold an uneasy truce; militia clashes and stalled elections recur.

rows.title: Western Sahara (Morocco–Polisario)
rows.event: Low-level hostilities resumed after the 2020 ceasefire collapse; a UN-mediated status process remains stalled.

rows.title: Egypt — Sinai insurgency
rows.event: Militant activity in northern Sinai has declined substantially after prolonged military operations.

rows.title: Tunisia — Political crisis
rows.event: Executive consolidation of power and opposition arrests keep governance contested.

rows.title: Mali — Jihadist insurgency (JNIM/ISGS)
rows.event: Al-Qaeda- and IS-affiliated groups expand amid the junta's pivot to Russian security partners and UN mission exit.

rows.title: Burkina Faso — Insurgency
rows.event: One of the world's fastest-growing displacement crises; large territory outside state control.

rows.title: Niger — Insurgency & instability
rows.event: Post-coup junta realigned away from Western partners as tri-border militant violence persists.

rows.title: Nigeria — Boko Haram / ISWAP
rows.event: Insurgency entrenched around Lake Chad; ISWAP has eclipsed the original Boko Haram faction.

rows.title: Nigeria — Banditry & farmer–herder
rows.event: Armed 'bandit' groups and communal violence drive mass kidnappings across the north-west and Middle Belt.

rows.title: Cameroon — Anglophone crisis
rows.event: Ambazonian separatists and security forces clash in the two Anglophone regions; dialogue stalled.

rows.title: Mali — Azawad / CSP-Tuareg
rows.event: Northern Tuareg coalition resumed fighting the state after the 2015 Algiers accord collapsed.

rows.title: Coastal spillover (Benin/Togo)
rows.event: Sahelian militancy is pushing south into littoral West African states' northern borderlands.

rows.title: Côte d'Ivoire — Northern spillover
rows.event: Occasional cross-border attacks from the Sahel; reinforced border deployments.

rows.title: Senegal — Casamance
rows.event: Africa's longest low-grade insurgency has wound down through successive peace deals.

rows.title: Guinea — Political instability
rows.event: Post-coup transition timeline and opposition restrictions keep politics tense.

rows.title: DRC — M23 / Rwanda
rows.event: Rwanda-backed M23 seized major eastern cities; a wider regional war risk looms over mineral-rich Kivus.

rows.title: DRC — ADF (eastern)
rows.event: IS-affiliated ADF conducts massacres in Ituri and North Kivu alongside a Ugandan joint operation.

rows.title: Central African Republic — Civil war
rows.event: Government, Russian partners and rebel coalitions hold a fragile balance; peace process partial.

rows.title: Uganda — ADF/LRA remnants
rows.event: LRA effectively defeated; residual ADF activity spills from the DRC.

rows.title: Rwanda–Burundi tensions
rows.event: Mutual accusations of backing rebels; periodic border closures amid the DRC crisis.

rows.title: Sudan — Civil War (SAF vs RSF)
rows.event: SAF–RSF war has triggered the world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; Darfur sees ethnic-targeted violence.

rows.title: Ethiopia — Amhara (Fano)
rows.event: Fano militia insurgency spread across Amhara after the Tigray war; federal offensives ongoing.

rows.title: Ethiopia — Oromia (OLA)
rows.event: Oromo Liberation Army insurgency persists amid failed talks.

rows.title: Somalia — Al-Shabaab
rows.event: Al-Shabaab remains resilient despite government offensives and an AU mission transition.

rows.title: South Sudan — Instability
rows.event: 2018 peace deal fraying; delayed elections and elite rivalry risk renewed war.

rows.title: Ethiopia–Somalia (Somaliland port)
rows.event: A Somaliland port-access MoU inflamed Addis Ababa–Mogadishu relations before Turkish-brokered de-escalation.

rows.title: Eritrea–Ethiopia tensions
rows.event: Post-Tigray fallout and Red Sea access ambitions raise the risk of renewed interstate conflict.

rows.title: Kenya — Al-Shabaab spillover
rows.event: Cross-border raids continue in the north-east and coast regions.

rows.title: Somaliland — Sool (SSC-Khaatumo)
rows.event: Clan-based forces wrested Sool region control from Somaliland, seeking federal recognition.

rows.title: Sudan–South Sudan (Abyei)
rows.event: Disputed, oil-adjacent Abyei remains under an expiring UN interim arrangement.

rows.title: Mozambique — Cabo Delgado (ISIS-M)
rows.event: IS-linked insurgency near gas projects; Rwandan and SADC forces contain but have not ended it.

rows.title: India–China LAC Standoff (Ladakh)
rows.event: Disengagement reached at most friction points; patrolling arrangements restored on parts of the LAC.

rows.title: India–Pakistan LoC Tensions
rows.event: A ceasefire understanding holds after a 2025 escalation; cross-border militancy remains the core dispute.

rows.title: Afghanistan — Taliban vs ISKP
rows.event: ISKP mounts periodic mass-casualty attacks against the Taliban government and minorities.

rows.title: Afghanistan–Pakistan (TTP/border)
rows.event: TTP attacks surged from Afghan soil; Islamabad–Kabul relations deteriorated with cross-border strikes.

rows.title: Pakistan — Balochistan insurgency
rows.event: Baloch separatists escalated attacks on security forces and Chinese/CPEC interests.

rows.title: India — Manipur ethnic conflict
rows.event: Meitei–Kuki violence displaced tens of thousands; the state remains effectively partitioned.

rows.title: India — Naxalite (Maoist)
rows.event: Maoist insurgency is at a historic low, confined to shrinking pockets of central India under a stated 2026 elimination goal.

rows.title: India — J&K militancy
rows.event: Militancy has ebbed but periodic attacks and infiltration continue post-2019 reorganisation.

rows.title: Pakistan–Iran border strikes
rows.event: Tit-for-tat strikes on militant havens in 2024 were quickly de-escalated diplomatically.

rows.title: Bangladesh — Political instability
rows.event: An interim government took over after mass protests ousted the prime minister; transition contested.

rows.title: India–Nepal (Kalapani)
rows.event: Overlapping Himalayan boundary claims remain unresolved but non-violent.

rows.title: China–Bhutan border
rows.event: Boundary talks continue amid Chinese construction in disputed areas that concern India.

rows.title: Myanmar — Civil War
rows.event: Post-coup junta is losing ground to a broad ethnic-resistance and PDF alliance across multiple fronts.

rows.title: Philippines — NPA insurgency
rows.event: The communist NPA is much weakened; localised clashes and peace overtures continue.

rows.title: Philippines — Mindanao (ASG/BIFF)
rows.event: BARMM autonomy has reduced violence; splinter militant cells persist.

rows.title: Thailand — South (Patani)
rows.event: A low-grade Malay-Muslim insurgency continues in the deep south amid on-off talks.

rows.title: Indonesia — Papua
rows.event: West Papua liberation fighters clash with security forces; access tightly restricted.

rows.title: Taiwan Strait tensions
rows.event: Record PLA air and naval incursions and drills raise cross-strait invasion and blockade concerns.

rows.title: Korean Peninsula (DPRK)
rows.event: North Korean missile tests, a scrapped inter-Korean posture and DPRK–Russia alignment heighten risk.

rows.title: South China Sea disputes
rows.event: China–Philippines standoffs at Second Thomas/Scarborough Shoals recur amid competing claims.

rows.title: Senkaku/Diaoyu (China–Japan)
rows.event: Chinese coast-guard patrols near Japan-administered islands sustain a simmering dispute.

rows.title: Japan–Russia (Kuril Islands)
rows.event: No WWII peace treaty; the dispute hardened further after 2022.

rows.title: Mexico — Cartel war
rows.event: Cartel fragmentation drives homicides, disappearances and fentanyl trafficking; a militarised response continues.

rows.title: Haiti — Gang crisis
rows.event: Armed gangs control most of the capital; a Kenya-led multinational mission struggles to restore order.

rows.title: Colombia — ELN / FARC dissidents
rows.event: 'Total Peace' talks stall as ELN and FARC-dissident factions fight over coca and mining economies.

rows.title: Venezuela–Guyana (Essequibo)
rows.event: Caracas revived a claim to two-thirds of Guyana around the oil-rich Essequibo, prompting a regional standoff.

rows.title: Ecuador — Narco violence
rows.event: A declared 'internal armed conflict' against gangs after prison takeovers and a TV-station siege.

rows.title: Venezuela — Political crisis
rows.event: A disputed 2024 election deepened the standoff between Maduro and the opposition amid emigration.

rows.title: Brazil — Militia & faction violence
rows.event: Rio militias and the PCC/CV drug factions contest territory in major cities.

rows.title: Central America — El Salvador crackdown
rows.event: A prolonged state of exception slashed gang homicides amid mass-detention rights concerns.

rows.title: Honduras — Gang violence
rows.event: MS-13 and Barrio 18 drive violence; a state of exception is in force.

rows.title: Nicaragua — Repression
rows.event: Post-2018 crackdown entrenched authoritarian rule and mass exile of the opposition.

rows.title: Peru — Political unrest
rows.event: Recurrent protests and instability since the 2022 presidential crisis, especially in the south.

rows.title: Chile — Araucanía (Mapuche)
rows.event: Mapuche land conflict with forestry firms and the state sees periodic arson and clashes.

rows.title: Kosovo–Serbia tensions
rows.event: Serb-majority north sees recurrent violence; EU-facilitated normalisation is stalled.

rows.title: Cyprus — Division
rows.event: The island stays split between the Republic and the Turkish-Cypriot north; talks dormant.

rows.title: Bosnia — Republika Srpska
rows.event: Serb-entity secessionist rhetoric and institutional defiance strain the Dayton settlement.

rows.title: Greece–Turkey (Aegean/EEZ)
rows.event: Overlapping airspace and maritime-zone claims persist despite a recent diplomatic thaw.

rows.title: Spain — Catalonia
rows.event: The independence push has cooled into a political/amnesty track after 2017.

rows.title: Tajikistan–Kyrgyzstan border
rows.event: Deadly 2021–22 clashes gave way to a delimitation deal reducing tensions.

rows.title: Afghanistan–Iran (water/border)
rows.event: Helmand water-rights disputes and border skirmishes recur with the Taliban government.
